answer: Non-kin attestation quorums resist sybils: an identity counts only once enough established, UNRELATED peers vouch for it, and self-referential rings are discounted. A fake cluster is a closed loop vouching only for itself, unable to wander past its own delta. Honest identities gather many independent vouches, solid as marble; a ring has only its own, so the counting rule starves it however large it grows.
